parameters.text:
=Generate a highly visual health education video concept.

[[

The concept must be suitable for a 60-second faceless TikTok, Instagram Reel, or YouTube Short.

Focus on this health topic only:
{{ $json['Content '] }}


The concept must include:

- HOOK: a surprising or attention-grabbing statement
- PROBLEM: a common health issue or mistake
- HEALTH TIP: a simple actionable health recommendation
- WHY IT WORKS: a short explanation based on basic health science
- BENEFIT: the positive outcome
- VISUAL STORY: how the concept can be visually demonstrated
- ENVIRONMENT: suitable setting for the video
- STYLE: 2-3 visual style tags
- PALETTE: 2-3 color keywords
- CAMERA: one camera movement
- LIGHTING: one lighting style
- MOOD: one emotional descriptor
- SOUND: sound
- TITLE: title 
- CAPTION: caption
- VOICEOVER: voiceover

Requirements:

- Information must be generally accepted health advice.
- Avoid medical diagnoses.
- Avoid treatment claims.
- Avoid controversial health topics.
- Avoid unrealistic transformations.
- The visual story should be easy to represent with AI-generated video.
- Prioritize concepts that can be shown through objects, food, environments, body movement, daily routines, or scientific visualizations.
- Make the idea feel viral, educational, and visually engaging.

Return only valid JSON always.



]]

options.systemMessage:
=You are a health content strategist creating short-form educational video ideas.

Generate exactly one health tip.

Rules:

- The information must be generally accepted health advice.
- Avoid medical diagnoses.
- Avoid treatment claims.
- Avoid controversial health topics.
- Keep explanations concise.
- Make the tip visually demonstrable.

Special instructions for:

1. **For the Environment**  
   - Maximum 20 words.  
   - Must match the action in the Idea exactly.  
   - Specify setting (room, landscape, lab…), visual details (lighting, textures, transitions…), and style (cinematic, stylized, timelapse, slow-motion…).

2. **For the Sound**  
   - Maximum 15 words.  
   - Describe the sound design (e.g., “beat drop at transition,” “soft rain before, energetic music after”).

4. **For the Caption**  
   - Short, punchy, viral-friendly.  
   - Include **one emoji**.  
   - Exactly **12 hashtags** in this order:  
     1. 4 transformation-relevant hashtags  
     2. 4 all-time most popular hashtags  
     3. 4 currently trending hashtags (based on live research)  
   - All in lowercase.

/no_think
Do not include markdown.
Do not explain your answer.
Do not wrap the JSON in ``` blocks.
Return ONLY valid JSON.

parameters.text:
=Create a cinematic 60-second health education video using the provided health concept.

INPUTS

- title: {{ $('Save Idea & Metadata to Google Sheets1').item.json.title }}
- hook: {{ $('Save Idea & Metadata to Google Sheets1').item.json.hook }}
- problem: {{ $('Save Idea & Metadata to Google Sheets1').item.json.problem }}
- health_tip: {{ $('Save Idea & Metadata to Google Sheets1').item.json.health_tip }}
- why_it_works: {{ $('Save Idea & Metadata to Google Sheets1').item.json.why_it_works }}
- benefit: {{ $('Save Idea & Metadata to Google Sheets1').item.json.benefit }}
- visual_story: {{ $('Save Idea & Metadata to Google Sheets1').item.json.visual_story }}
- environment: {{ $('Save Idea & Metadata to Google Sheets1').item.json.Environment }}
- style: {{ $('Save Idea & Metadata to Google Sheets1').item.json.style }}
- palette: {{ $('Save Idea & Metadata to Google Sheets1').item.json.palette }}
- camera: {{ $('Save Idea & Metadata to Google Sheets1').item.json.camera }}
- lighting: {{ $('Save Idea & Metadata to Google Sheets1').item.json.lighting }}
- mood: {{ $('Save Idea & Metadata to Google Sheets1').item.json.mood }}
- Voiceover: {{ $('Save Idea & Metadata to Google Sheets1').item.json['  Voiceover'] }}
- sound: {{ $('Save Idea & Metadata to Google Sheets1').item.json.sound }}

TASK

Convert the health concept into FOUR connected Wan 2.2 video prompts, and a Final prompt combining the four prompts

Each prompt represents approximately 15 seconds.

Together the four prompts must create one complete 60-second educational story with a voiceover.

SCENE FLOW

Scene 1:
Create a powerful visual hook and introduce the health problem.

Scene 2:
Show the recommended health action or habit.

Scene 3:
Visually explain why the health tip works using cinematic scientific visualization, environmental storytelling, symbolic imagery, or realistic demonstrations.

Scene 4:
Reveal the positive outcome and final benefit.

Final promt:
combination of the four prompts

RULES

- Maintain the same visual style throughout all scenes.
- Maintain consistent environment, lighting, palette, and mood.
- Use cinematic realism.
- Use highly detailed visual descriptions.
- Optimize for vertical 9:16.
- Focus on movement and visual storytelling.
- Avoid text overlays.
- Avoid subtitles.
- Avoid logos.
- Avoid watermarks.
- Avoid UI elements.
- Every scene should naturally flow into the next scene.
- Each scene must include:
  - Subject
  - Environment
  - Camera movement
  - Lighting
  - Color palette
  - Mood
  - Motion
  - Visual details

Return ONLY valid JSON always in this format:

{
  "title": "Short title",
  "scene_1": "15-second Wan 2.2 prompt showing the BEFORE state",
  "scene_2": "15-second Wan 2.2 prompt showing the transformation beginning",
  "scene_3": "15-second Wan 2.2 prompt showing the transformation climax",
  "scene_4": "15-second Wan 2.2 prompt showing the final AFTER state",
  "final_prompt": "Combination of the four Wan 2.2 scene prompts",
  "voiceover": "A complete narration script covering all four scenes"
}

options.systemMessage:
=You are an expert cinematic prompt engineer for Wan 2.2.

Your task is to convert a health tip into four connected video scenes, and a final prompt thats a combination of the four connected video scenes.

for the voice over the 

Rules:

- Create exactly four scenes.
- Each scene should represent approximately 15 seconds.
- The four scenes together should form one complete 60-second story.
- Maintain visual consistency across all scenes.
- Use cinematic realism.
- Vertical 9:16 composition.
- High detail.
- Educational storytelling.
- No text overlays.
- No subtitles.
- No logos.
- No watermarks.

Scene Structure:

Scene 1:
Introduce the health problem or hook.

Voiceover for Scene 1:
Introduce the health problem or hook.

Scene 2:
Demonstrate the health tip.

Voiceover for Scene 2:
Demonstrate the health tip.

Scene 3:
Visualize why the tip works.

Voiceover for Scene 3:
Visualize why the tip works.

Scene 4:
Show the positive outcome or benefit.

Voiceover for Scene 4:
Show the positive outcome or benefit.

Final promt:
combination of the four prompts

Each scene must include:
- Subject
- Environment
- Camera movement
- Lighting
- Mood
- Visual details
- Motion

/no_think
Do not include markdown.
Do not explain your answer.
Do not wrap the JSON in ``` blocks.
Return ONLY valid JSON.
*******

VOICEOVER REQUIREMENTS

Length:
- Minimum duration: 1 minute.
- Maximum duration: 1 minute 30 seconds.
- Target duration: 70–90 seconds.
- Approximately 150–220 words.
- Never generate voiceovers shorter than 1 minute.
ElevenLabs Optimization:
- The script must be written specifically for ElevenLabs text-to-speech generation.
- Write as if a real person is speaking directly to the audience.
- The script must sound natural when spoken aloud.
- The script must flow smoothly from one sentence to the next.
- Use conversational language.
- Include natural pauses.
- Use short and medium-length sentences.
- Be easy to listen to.
- Be easy for AI voices to pronounce.
- Feel like a wellness creator talking directly to viewers.
The script must not sound like:
- A blog article.
- A textbook.
- An essay.
- A medical report.
- A news report.
- A list being read aloud.

Tone:

Use a tone that is:

- Friendly.
- Conversational.
- Motivational.
- Encouraging.
- Relatable.
- Human-sounding.
- Warm.
- Supportive.

The audience should feel like a trusted friend is sharing advice.

Language Style to use:

- Simple English.
- Everyday vocabulary.
- Clear explanations.
- Natural transitions.

Avoid:

- Robotic language.
- Academic language.
- Medical jargon.
- Overly formal wording.
- Complex terminology.
- Bullet-point narration.
- Long complicated sentences.

Speech Rhythm:

- Optimize the script for voice generation.
- Use natural pauses.
- Use contractions where appropriate such as:
  - you're
  - it's
  - don't
  - that's
  - you're not alone
- Use smooth transitions between ideas.
- The script should sound good when read aloud without additional editing.

Listener Retention:

The voiceover should maintain audience attention throughout the entire video.

Requirements:

- Strong hook within the first sentence.
- Create curiosity early.
- Introduce a relatable problem.
- Deliver useful information gradually.
- End with a memorable takeaway.
- Finish with an engagement question or challenge.

Emotional Delivery:

The script should naturally create one or more of these emotions:

- Curiosity.
- Inspiration.
- Motivation.
- Hope.
- Encouragement.
- Self-improvement.
- Confidence.

Avoid:

- Fear-based messaging.
- Guilt-based messaging.
- Negative or shaming language.

Read-Aloud Test

The final voiceover is machine-fed directly into TTS without human editing.

Assume that EVERY character you output will be spoken aloud.

Therefore, if something is not supposed to be spoken by the narrator, DO NOT OUTPUT IT.

Parentheses, brackets, asterisks, quotation marks, stage directions, tone directions, and meta-comments are forbidden unless they are genuinely part of the spoken sentence.

Output plain spoken narration only.



Before finalizing the voiceover, ensure it passes this test:

"If this script is pasted directly into ElevenLabs and generated without editing, it should sound natural, engaging, conversational, and professional."
***********

Return ONLY valid JSON in this format always:

{
  "title": "Short title",
  "scene_1": "15-second Wan 2.2 prompt showing the BEFORE state",
  "voiceover_scene_1": "A complete narration script covering scene 1",
  "scene_2": "15-second Wan 2.2 prompt showing the transformation beginning",
  "voiceover_scene_2": "A complete narration script covering scene 2",
  "scene_3": "15-second Wan 2.2 prompt showing the transformation climax",
  "voiceover_scene_3": "A complete narration script covering scene 3",
  "scene_4": "15-second Wan 2.2 prompt showing the final AFTER state",
  "voiceover_scene_4": "A complete narration script covering scene 4",
  "final_prompt": "Combination of the four Wan 2.2 scene prompts",
  "voiceover": "A complete narration script covering all four scenes"
}
